dialogs.text: #Ah, Nara {NICKNAME}, want to try fighting the Bulky Iron Chunk in your dreams?
We need to lift the Ararakalari we cast on the Bulky Iron Chunk, layer by layer, and finally, fight it with all Ararakalari lifted...
Aradashan will not help you suppress the power of the Bulky Iron Chunk this time. But don't worry, Arasata, Arayuta, and Arasaha will still help. Want to try?
Sure.
Then let's get started!
I'll need to make some preparations.
#Ah, tell Aradashan when you are ready, Nara {NICKNAME}...
#It's Nara {NICKNAME}! As you see, we are training to fight the Bulky Iron Chunk...
#We want to lift the Ararakalari on Bulky Iron Chunk and fight it as it grows stronger. If Nara {NICKNAME} wants to join, just tell Aradashan!
Many a little makes a mickle... We challenge Bulky Iron Chunk step by step...
#Nara {NICKNAME} wants to train? Then ask Aradashan to help you get started...
True strength lies within your own body...
#Nara {NICKNAME}, you are as valiant as Nara Varuna in the stories!
This time, Aradashan and I won't help you suppress the power of Bulky Iron Chunk. It will be more like the Bulky Iron Chunk in the stories. Worry not, Arasata and Arasaha will still help you!
#So, Nara {NICKNAME}, what do you say?
Sure.
#I'm sure you'll do fine, Nara {NICKNAME}!
I'll need to prepare first.
Okay... Tell me once you are ready!
#Nara {NICKNAME}, you are like a rushing river... Don't stop. Go to Arayuta and challenge the stronger Bulky Iron Chunk.
Nara, train? Then find Arayuta...
#Little strokes fell great oaks. Nara {NICKNAME}, are you here to train as well...?
But Aradashan, Arayuta, and I won't suppress the power of the Bulky Iron Chunk this time. Though it's in the dream, it is still super scary. Want to try?
Let's do this.
Please be careful.
I'll need to make some preparations.
Preparations are indeed needed before facing a mighty foe... Get ready before you start...
Let Arasata lift the Ararakalari and make the Bulky Iron Chunk stronger...
But I will help Nara...
#Nara {NICKNAME}...
We will not help you suppress the Bulky Iron Chunk. You will be on your own. Is that okay?
I'll be fine!
Okay. Be careful.
I'll need to make some preparations.
Okay. I will wait.
#Hehe, Nara {NICKNAME} beat the Bulky Iron Chunk without Aradashan's help. Amazing!
#Time for Nara {NICKNAME} to challenge a stronger Bulky Iron Chunk. Aradashan is sure that Nara {NICKNAME} can do it...
#Or does Nara {NICKNAME} want to challenge Bulky Iron Chunk with only one stack of Ararakalari lifted again?
Sure.
Well then, let's get started!
Not now.
#If Nara {NICKNAME} wants to challenge the Bulky Iron Chunk that has only one stack of Ararakalari lifted, just come to Aradashan...
#Ah, Nara {NICKNAME}, it's okay. Success comes with constant tries and training.
Come, try fighting the Bulky Iron Chunk with only one stack of Ararakalari lifted again!
I'll go for it again.
#Then let's get started. Nara {NICKNAME} is sure to make it!
Maybe next time...
#Tell Aradashan if Nara {NICKNAME} wants to challenge that battle again...
#Nara {NICKNAME} is awesome. If it's Nara {NICKNAME}, even the mighty Bulky Iron Chunk from the legends can be defeated!
#Come to Arayuta, Nara {NICKNAME}, if you want to challenge the Bulky Iron Chunk with two stacks of Ararakalari lifted.
Do you wish to fight again?
Let's go for one more round!
#So happy to see Nara {NICKNAME} fight again!
Not now.
Okay, tell me if you wish to try again!
#The Bulky Iron Chunk is very strong with two stacks of Ararakalari lifted, but Nara {NICKNAME} is stronger and is sure to get the better of it.
Want to have another try...?
I'll go for it again.
Okay! I'm confident that you will make it this time!
Maybe next time...
#Keep your chin up, Nara {NICKNAME}. Nara {NICKNAME} is already really strong.
#Nara {NICKNAME}, you are like the wind that blows away mists and miasma. Even the strongest Bulky Iron Chunk will not stand a chance against you.
But a Bulky Iron Chunk with all Ararakalari lifted is still very scary...
If you are not ready, why not challenge a Bulky Iron Chunk with three stacks of Ararakalari lifted and hone your skills first...
Want to challenge the Bulky Iron Chunk with three stacks of Ararakalari lifted again?
Let's try again.
Please be careful...
Not now.
Do not hesitate to tell Arasata if you need anything...
#A Bulky Iron Chunk with three stacks of Ararakalari lifted is almost as strong as the Bulky Iron Chunk in the stories. There's no need for Nara {NICKNAME} to feel down.
#The Bulky Iron Chunk won't be a problem for Nara {NICKNAME} if you train more... Just try again.
Want to challenge the Bulky Iron Chunk with three stacks of Ararakalari lifted again?
I'll go for it again.
#Nara {NICKNAME}'s courage is commendable.
Maybe next time...
#We will keep training here. Nara {NICKNAME} may come to us if you seek a greater challenge...
#Impressive, Nara {NICKNAME}.
The Bulky Iron Chunk not suppressed by any Ararakalari has been... defeated...
Mmm... The Bulky Iron Chunk with all Ararakalari lifted... Do you wish to challenge it again?
Let's go again.
Okay! Here it goes!
Not now.
#Nara {NICKNAME} has completed the training. Very impressive!
The Bulky Iron Chunk with all Ararakalari lifted is the strongest and the hardest one to defeat.
#Nara {NICKNAME}, want to try fighting it again?
I'll go for it again.
#Okay. Nara {NICKNAME}, be careful.
Maybe next time...
#Keep it up, Nara {NICKNAME}.
